newsitem.title: UK: LME kerb sees copper lower, others pare gains.
newsitem.headline: LME kerb sees copper lower, others pare gains.

text.p: COPPER - Cash/threes end AM at $65/$70 back from $100 Tuesday. 3months fails to hold $2,300. Ends at $2,287. ZINC - Touches seven-year high of $1,557, on consumer buying, Far East shortcovering. But pares gains on kerb. Cash/threes backwardation ends at $8/10 from $12/$14 peak. ALUMINIUM - Steady above $1,620. NICKEL - Slightly firmer. OTHERS - Quiet.
